part.text:
The robot is in front of the green panel at the end of the corridor, about 0.75 m away by sonar. I called rest, and it is now crouched with the motors off.

The corridor ran straight, then turned left at a blank end wall. The panel was at the end of that left leg. Collision protection stopped the robot a few times near the corner, but it didn't fall.
